name: Software Engineering
description: Core practices and technologies for designing, building, testing, deploying, and maintaining software systems.

name: Programming Languages
description: Programming language fundamentals, syntax, semantics, object-oriented programming, functional programming, and language-specific ecosystems.

name: Web Engineering
description: Frontend and backend web technologies, browser programming, web standards, APIs, and full-stack application development.

name: Backend Engineering
description: Server-side development, business logic, API design, database integration, authentication, and distributed application services.

name: Frontend Engineering
description: User interface architecture, component-based development, browser performance, accessibility, and client-side application engineering.

name: Full Stack Engineering
description: End-to-end application development across user interfaces, backend services, data storage, integration, and deployment.

name: Software Architecture and Design
description: Architectural styles, design principles, design patterns, modularity, scalability, maintainability, and system-level decision making.

name: Data Management and Databases
description: Data modeling, relational and NoSQL databases, SQL, transactions, data integrity, performance optimization, and database administration.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Cloud platforms, infrastructure, managed services, cloud-native application development, security, scalability, and cost management.

name: DevOps and Platform Engineering
description: CI/CD automation, infrastructure as code, container platforms, orchestration, deployment automation, and developer platform capabilities.

name: Operating Systems and Infrastructure
description: Operating system concepts, Linux administration, processes, memory, networking, virtualization, and server infrastructure.

name: Quality Engineering
description: Software quality assurance, manual testing, automated testing, API testing, performance testing, and continuous quality practices.

name: Cybersecurity
description: Application security, identity and access management, secure coding, vulnerability management, network security, and threat mitigation.

name: Distributed Systems Engineering
description: Microservices, messaging, distributed communication, fault tolerance, consistency, resilience, and scalable multi-service applications.

name: Artificial Intelligence Engineering
description: AI application development, model integration, machine learning, LLM applications, RAG, tool calling, evaluation, and responsible AI practices.

name: Data Engineering and Analytics
description: Data pipelines, data transformation, ingestion, warehousing, analytics infrastructure, and data processing systems.

name: Networking and Communications
description: Network protocols, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, routing, sockets, network security, and troubleshooting distributed applications.

name: Mobile Application Engineering
description: Mobile user interfaces, application lifecycle, device integration, mobile APIs, performance, and cross-platform development.

name: Embedded Systems Engineering
description: Firmware, microcontrollers, hardware interfaces, real-time systems, low-level programming, and resource-constrained applications.

name: Automation and Scripting
description: Automating repetitive tasks, infrastructure operations, application workflows, testing activities, and system administration using scripts.

name: Technical Leadership
description: Technical decision making, engineering mentorship, code reviews, architecture guidance, team collaboration, and engineering delivery.

name: Product Engineering and Delivery
description: Requirements analysis, product development, Agile practices, backlog management, iterative delivery, and continuous improvement.

name: Professional and Career Skills
description: Communication, collaboration, problem solving, workplace readiness, adaptability, professional conduct, and continuous learning.

name: Blockchain Engineering
description: Distributed ledgers, smart contracts, cryptographic foundations, decentralized applications, and blockchain integration.

name: Internet of Things Engineering
description: Connected devices, sensor integration, device communication, telemetry, edge computing, and IoT platform development.
